game.directory.empty: Empty state of a game's player directory; {game} is the game.
game.directory.empty.filtered: Empty state of a game's player directory when filters are applied; {game} is the game.
game.players.column.events: Player directory column: how many events the player entered.
game.players.column.main: Player directory column: the character the player uses most.
game.players.column.standing: Player directory column: rank and rating on the player's home community's board.
game.players.column.winRate: Player directory column: share of sets won.
game.players.count: After a formatted count in the player directory's lead line, as in "5,634 players".
game.players.eyebrow: Eyebrow over the game's name on the player directory.
game.players.search: Placeholder of the player directory search.
game.players.sort.alphabetical: Sort choice for the player directory.
game.players.sort.events: Sort choice: most events entered first.
game.players.sort.winRate: Sort choice: highest share of sets won first.
game.players.standing.in: Between a rank and a community's name in the Standing cell, as in "#34 in LLB Stadium".
game.players.updated: Before the date the player directory's figures were last computed.
game.tournaments.column.strength: Tournament archive column: how strong the field was.
game.tournaments.column.tournament: Tournament archive column: the tournament's name.
game.tournaments.hidden: Marker on a tournament only moderators can see.
game.tournaments.hidden.title: Tooltip on the Hidden marker.
game.tournaments.includedVia: Tooltip on a community archive row counted through another community; {name} is that community.
game.tournaments.search: Placeholder of the tournament archive search.
game.tournaments.sort.alphabetical: Sort choice for the tournament archive.
game.tournaments.sort.prizePool: Sort choice: biggest prize pool first.
game.tournaments.suggestHeading: Heading over search suggestions drawn from the tournament archive.
game.tournaments.title: Title of a game's tournament archive.
game.tournaments.via: On a community archive row counted through another community; {name} is that community.
game.tournaments.vod: Accessible name of the icon marking a tournament with recorded video.
game.upcoming.empty: Empty upcoming-events list; {name} is a game or a community.
game.upcoming.eyebrow: Eyebrow over the game's name on its upcoming events page.
game.upcoming.meta.description: Search-engine description of a game's upcoming events. Dizzy is the site's name.
game.upcoming.meta.title: Page title of a game's upcoming events.
